title: Austin Examined Utility Budgets
summary:
*   City leaders dedicated a special meeting to comprehensive budget reviews for critical city services.
*   Discussions focused on the financial health and future spending of the Water and Wastewater Department.
*   The Electric Utility's budget also underwent a thorough examination by city officials.
*   The meeting served as a worksession for understanding financial details, not for immediate policy decisions.
